resenas.texto: I've been coming to Sulu lashes for about a year now and I love the work Jojo has done every time. She's detail-oriented, has never canceled or shown up late on me. She's absolutely professional!

Cholpon is amazing the best lash studio I’ve ever been too. I love my lashes every time i get them done! Appointments always run on time! If i have any questions she’s ready to answer! Definitely recommend! Getting ready for my refill and my lashes still look great!

I wish I could give 10 stars for the service that I’ve received. I’m a new customer, but my latest visit was the most amazing. My Tech suggested a new look and it was executed better than I ever could’ve imagined. I’ve been getting extensions for years, but didn’t fully understand what I was getting and the differences between the looks.
